authorization: Owner chose this design at stage 4 of the shared component contract (DEVELOPMENT decision 37). Scoring waits for the owner to retain this plan.

question.hypothesis: Lesion-associated epithelial programmes add to a shared plasticity component.
question.test: Does the frozen lesion-specific module rise in lung adenocarcinoma epithelium relative to the same patient's normal type 2 cells, in a cohort never scored with it?

discovery.role: discovery only; already scored and reported, so it cannot also evaluate
discovery.module_identity: lesion_specific is gene-for-gene identical to HPCS_without_ADI_or_operational_markers, scored by the completed human run
discovery.configuration: unc20_pooled, label AT2, cell floor 50, LUAD minus normal

cohort.pairing_evidence: the deposit's Feature Summary patient id column, not sample-name resemblance
cohort.prior_use: opened once, for trial E1 on EGFR ligand RNA; never scored with any module in this plan

lesion_arm.pooling: all three pooled; no subtype selected

populations.difference_from_discovery: Discovery used atlas-mapped type 2-like cells in both arms, which in lesions included lesional cells resembling type 2. Here the lesion arm is all tumour epithelium by author label. This is a stricter transport test. A positive result survives a change of cell definition; a negative one may reflect it.
populations.malignancy: The author annotation has no copy-number malignancy label, so the lesion arm may include non-malignant epithelium.

eligibility.cell_floor_origin: inherited from the discovery primary configuration, not chosen for this cohort
eligibility.gate1_statistic: assayed source fraction: strict one-to-one ortholog, then presence in the Kim gene index, over the module's mouse length
eligibility.on_gate_failure: a module failing gate 1 is not scored; if the primary fails, the test is not run and the result is recorded as ineligible

scoring.instrument: the discovery run's own procedure in Research Article/gate2_C3_yu_lee_choi_min_2026/trials/u5_human_paired_pathways.R
scoring.pseudobulk: sum raw UMI over the arm's cells for each patient
scoring.normalization: edgeR calcNormFactors method TMM across all eligible pseudobulks together, then cpm with log TRUE and prior.count 1
scoring.module_score: mean logCPM over the module's genes present in the gene index
scoring.difference: lesion arm score minus normal arm score, per patient
scoring.instrument_check: Before any Kim score, the same code must reproduce the discovery's tracked per-patient differences for this module from the cached discovery pseudobulks, within 1e-6. If it cannot, Kim is not scored and the discrepancy is reported.

primary.estimand: mean within-patient difference, lesion epithelium minus normal type 2
primary.estimate: Hodges-Lehmann with exact 95 percent confidence interval

decision_rules.transports: p below 0.05 and estimate above zero
decision_rules.contradicts: p below 0.05 and estimate below zero
decision_rules.precisely_absent: upper bound of the exact 95 percent interval below 0.10; retires the specified addition only

secondary.family: Benjamini-Hochberg across the three tests below, q below 0.05, same test as primary

tests.name: beyond_shared
tests.estimand: per-patient lesion_specific difference minus shared_remodelling difference

tests.name: stress_excluded
tests.definition: lesion_specific minus every gene in the three frozen mouse Hallmark control sets

descriptive_only: type 1 and type 2 identity axis differences
leave-one-patient-out range of the primary mean
the primary excluding the double-primary patient P0028

power.consequence: A null result is inconclusive unless the precise-absence rule is met, which is unlikely with this many patients.

prohibited_readings: A null is not a refutation unless the precise-absence rule is met.
Tumour epithelium is not confirmed malignant.
Same-patient pairing controls donor, not stage, smoking or driver status, which vary across patients.
A positive result supports transport of this addition; it does not show that no other lesion programme exists.
order: commit this contract and the plan
run the eligibility gates and commit their tables
owner retains or revises the plan
scoring run, whose first step is the instrument check
